I login with valid credentials
I should see the dashboard
Navigate to settings page , Open the Pipeline Tab
Using the Create Pipeline , Adding the Pipeline

Navigate to the Pipeline
Edit the Pipeline
Updated the Pipeline Sucessfully

elements.name: With Existing Pipeline Name , The New Pipeline Should not create

steps.name: Navigate to the Pipeline
Using the Create Pipeline , Enter the exiting pipeline name and create
It should display an error message "Pipeline already exists, kindly update the name and try again."
Navigate to the Pipeline
Clicking on Edit Pipeline , Delete the Pipeline
Pipeline Should be deleted Sucessfully

elements.name: Creating a new Pipeline for Campaing Creation

steps.name: Navigate to settings page , Open the Pipeline Tab
Using the Create Pipeline , Adding the Pipeline
I should see the Pipeline in the Pipeline list
Choosing the Pipeline where to Create the Campaign
Click on Create Campaign
Give the Name for Campaign
Choosing the Users to assign inside the Campaign
Choosing the Lead Distribution type
Campaign should create successfully
Upload Leads After Campaign Creation
Mapping the Fields the with the Column in the excel
Lead Should Upload successfully

steps.name: Opening the lead Summary page inside the campaign
All the Leads will Display

elements.name: Change lead status to In Progress using bulk update

steps.name: Go to the Campaign lead summary page
I select the lead Summary page
Update the lead Stage to inprogress and update the follow up date
all the leads should be updated to In Progress in the lead summary page
Switch to admin Portal and select the Pipeline
Creating a New Campaign for copy leads
Copying Leads from existing campaign to Another Campaign
Verify all the leads are copied to the destination Campaign
Switch to admin Portal for move leads and select the Pipeline
Creating a New Campaign for move leads
Move Leads from existing campaign to Another Campaign
Verify all the leads are moved to the destination Campaign
